RTS_030.what: The route vehicle type uses a non-standard extended code; some apps may not recognise it.
RTS_030.action: If possible, choose the nearest basic vehicle type (bus, tram, metro, etc.).

RTS_031.title: Route code is empty
RTS_031.what: A route in the route list has an empty code; trips cannot be linked to it.
RTS_031.action: Give each route a unique code.

SAR_001.title: Area not found in a stop–area link
SAR_001.what: A stop is assigned to a fare area that is not defined.
SAR_001.action: Assign the stop to an existing fare area.

SAR_002.title: Stop not found in a stop–area link
SAR_002.what: A fare area is assigned a stop that is not in the stop list.
SAR_002.action: Assign an existing stop to the area.

SAR_003.title: Area empty in a stop–area link
SAR_003.what: A stop–area link has no area.
SAR_003.action: Enter the fare area for the link.

SAR_004.title: Stop empty in a stop–area link
SAR_004.what: A stop–area link has no stop.
SAR_004.action: Enter the stop for the link.

SHP_001.title: Shape code is empty
SHP_001.what: A shape point does not say which shape it belongs to.
SHP_001.action: Export the route shape again from your scheduling software.

SHP_002.title: Shape point latitude invalid
SHP_002.what: A point in a route shape has no latitude or it is out of range.
SHP_002.action: Check the shape on the map and redraw or export it again.

SHP_003.title: Shape point longitude invalid
SHP_003.what: A point in a route shape has no longitude or it is out of range.
SHP_003.action: Check the shape on the map and redraw or export it again.

SHP_004.title: Shape point order invalid
SHP_004.what: A shape point has no sequence number or it is not a number; the line may be joined wrongly.

SHP_005.title: Shape distance goes backwards
SHP_005.what: Along a route shape, a point’s distance is smaller than the previous point’s.
SHP_005.action: Have the shape distances recalculated so they increase from start to end.

SHP_006.title: Shape is a single point
SHP_006.what: A route shape consists of a single point; it cannot be drawn as a line.
SHP_006.action: Redraw the shape along the road.

SHP_008.title: Same order used twice in a shape
SHP_008.what: Two points of a route shape share the same sequence number; the line’s direction is unclear.

SHP_009.title: Shape crosses itself
SHP_009.what: A route shape passes over itself. This is normal at loops and turning points.
SHP_009.action: If the route really uses the same road this is fine; otherwise check the shape on the map.

SHP_010.title: Same point repeated in a shape
SHP_010.what: The same location is entered twice in a row in a route shape.
SHP_010.action: Simplify the shape and export it again; riders are not affected.

SHP_012.title: Shape far from the trip’s stops
SHP_012.what: A route shape passes more than 100 metres from some stops of the trips that use it; stops appear off the road on the map.
SHP_012.action: Correct the shape or the stop locations; the trip may have the wrong shape.

SHP_014.title: First or last stop far from the shape end
SHP_014.what: The trip’s first or last stop is far from the start or end of the route shape.
SHP_014.action: If it is a deliberate extension (e.g. depot exit) this is fine; otherwise adjust the shape ends to the terminal stops.

SHP_015.title: Shape drawn with too few points
SHP_015.what: A long route shape is drawn with very few points; on the map it does not follow the road and cuts through buildings.
SHP_015.action: Redraw the shape along the road with more points.

SHP_016.title: Shape runs against the trip direction
SHP_016.what: A route shape is drawn in the opposite direction to the trips that use it; apps show the direction reversed.
SHP_016.action: Reverse the shape for this direction or define a separate shape.

SHP_017.title: Stop order conflicts with the shape
SHP_017.what: The trip’s stop order seems to go backwards along the route shape. This can happen on loop routes.
SHP_017.action: Check on the map; if it is a deliberate turn this is fine, otherwise correct the stop order or the shape.

SHP_018.title: Unused route shape
SHP_018.what: No trip uses this route shape.
SHP_018.action: Link the shape to the relevant trips, or delete it if unused.

SHP_019.title: Shape’s trips have no stop times
SHP_019.what: None of the trips using a route shape has stop times.
SHP_019.action: Add the trips’ stop times, or remove the unused trips and shape.

SHP_020.title: Point repeats in a shape
SHP_020.what: The same point recurs shortly within a route shape. This is for information.
SHP_020.action: You may simplify the shape and export it again; riders are not affected.

SHP_021.title: Shape distance negative
SHP_021.what: A route shape point has a distance below zero.

SHP_022.title: Stop position on the shape is ambiguous
SHP_022.what: Because the shape passes the same place more than once, it is unclear where on the line a stop is.
SHP_022.action: Export each stop’s distance along the shape in the trip stop times.

SHP_023.title: Same point twice in a shape
SHP_023.what: The same location and distance are entered twice in a row in a route shape.
SHP_023.action: Remove the duplicate point and export again.

SHP_024.title: Stop distances along the shape are inconsistent
SHP_024.what: Stops’ distances along the shape do not match the stop locations.
SHP_024.action: Check the stop locations, the shape and the distances.

SHP_025.title: Trip distance longer than the shape
SHP_025.what: The distance in trip stop times exceeds the total length of the route shape; different units were probably used.
SHP_025.action: Export the distance in the same unit (metres or kilometres) in both places.

SHP_026.title: Shape has very many points
SHP_026.what: A route shape has more than 5000 points; the file grows unnecessarily. This is for information.
SHP_026.action: You can use the shape simplification option when exporting.

SHP_028.title: Position changes without distance increasing
SHP_028.what: Two consecutive shape points are at different places but have the same distance.

SHP_029.title: Two almost identical shape points
SHP_029.what: Two consecutive shape points are very close and have the same distance; this may be rounding. This is for information.
SHP_029.action: Have the shape distances recalculated, or remove the duplicate point.

SHP_030.title: Stop distance present, shape distance missing
SHP_030.what: Trip stop times use shape distances but the route shape has none; the two cannot be matched.
SHP_030.action: Add distances in the same unit to the shape, or remove the distances from the stop times.

STM_001.title: Stop times are not linked to a route
STM_001.what: There are times for a {stop_count}-stop trip starting at {first_stop} at {first_departure} and ending at {last_stop} at {last_arrival}, but no route or service calendar is defined for this trip.
STM_001.action: In the planning software, find the trip that uses these stops and times, assign its correct service calendar, and link it to a route.

STM_002.title: A stop used by a trip was not found
STM_002.what: A trip on route code {route_code} under the {service} calendar uses this stop during {time}, but the stop is missing from the stop list.
STM_002.action: Check the trip's location in the planning software. If it is a physical stop, match it to an existing stop or create a stop record. If it represents a service area, do not add it as a stop; use the correct location type and record in the trip.

STM_003.title: Arrival time invalid
STM_003.what: An arrival time at a stop cannot be read or is not in a valid format.
STM_003.action: Correct the trip’s arrival time at the stop.

STM_004.title: Departure time invalid
STM_004.what: A departure time at a stop cannot be read or is not in a valid format.
STM_004.action: Correct the trip’s departure time from the stop.

STM_005.title: Stop sequence of the trip invalid
STM_005.what: The trip’s stop sequence is missing or invalid.
STM_005.action: Correct the missing or invalid stop sequence values.

STM_006.title: No stop given in the trip
STM_006.what: No stop is selected for the stop time with arrival {arrival} and departure {departure}.
STM_006.action: In your scheduling software, add the stop planned for these times.

STM_007.title: Departure appears before arrival
STM_007.what: At the same stop the departure time is earlier than the arrival time.
STM_007.action: Check the arrival and departure times at the stop.

STM_008.title: Time goes backwards between stops
STM_008.what: After departing {from} at {dep}, the trip arrives at {to} at {arr}, which is before the departure.
STM_008.action: Check the times of these two stops in your scheduling software; times must move forward along the trip. After midnight, times continue past 24:00 (e.g. 24:10, not 00:10).

STM_009.title: Pickup rule at a stop invalid
STM_009.what: The value saying whether riders can board at a trip’s stop is not one of the defined options.
STM_009.action: In your scheduling software, set the pickup method for this stop: 0 — regularly scheduled pickup; 1 — no pickup; 2 — phone the agency to arrange pickup; 3 — coordinate with the driver to arrange pickup.

STM_010.title: Drop-off rule at a stop invalid
STM_010.what: The value saying whether riders can alight at a trip’s stop is not one of the defined options.
STM_010.action: In your scheduling software, set the drop-off method for this stop: 0 — regularly scheduled drop-off; 1 — no drop-off; 2 — phone the agency to arrange drop-off; 3 — coordinate with the driver to arrange drop-off.

STM_012.title: Unrealistic speed between stops
STM_012.what: The calculated speed between {stops} does not appear realistic.
STM_012.action: First check the arrival and departure times between these two stops. If the times are correct, check the stop locations.

STM_014.title: Excessive speed on a route segment
STM_014.what: Between {from} and {to}, the calculated speed over {distance} m is {speed} km/h, above the {threshold} km/h limit set for this route type.
STM_014.action: Check these two stops’ times. If the times are right, look at the stops’ locations on the map.

STM_015.title: The first stop is missing an arrival time
STM_015.what: The arrival time for the first stop of this trip is missing.
STM_015.action: Enter the arrival time at the first stop of this trip. At the first stop it is usually the same as the departure time.

STM_016.title: The last stop is missing an arrival time
STM_016.what: The arrival time for the last stop of this trip is missing.
STM_016.action: Enter the arrival time at the last stop of this trip; it must come after the previous stop.

STM_017.title: Cumulative distance of stops along the route is missing
STM_017.what: The cumulative distance from the start of the route is missing at the trip’s stops.
STM_017.action: Enter a consistent cumulative distance from the start of the route at the stops of the affected trips.

STM_018.title: Continuous pickup setting invalid on a route section
STM_018.what: The continuous pickup setting after {stop} is written as “{value}”. This is not one of the defined options.
STM_018.action: Choose the correct pickup option for this route section: 0 — boarding between stops is allowed; 1 — no boarding between stops; 2 — arrange by phone; 3 — arrange with the driver. Leave this field empty to inherit the route-wide setting.

STM_019.title: Continuous drop-off setting invalid on a route section
STM_019.what: The continuous drop-off setting after {stop} is written as “{value}”. This is not one of the defined options.
STM_019.action: Choose the correct drop-off option for this route section: 0 — alighting between stops is allowed; 1 — no alighting between stops; 2 — arrange by phone; 3 — arrange with the driver. Leave this field empty to inherit the route-wide setting.

STM_020.title: Zero travel time between distant stops
STM_020.what: Two consecutive stops more than 200 metres apart have the same minute; the vehicle appears to travel without taking any time.
STM_020.action: Correct the two stops’ times to the real travel time.

STM_021.title: Two consecutive stops at the same place
STM_021.what: Two different consecutive stops in the trip appear at the same point on the map.
STM_021.action: Check both stop locations; enter the right location if they differ, merge them if they are copies.

STM_022.title: Timepoint flag invalid
STM_022.what: The flag saying whether a stop time is exact or approximate is not a defined value.
STM_022.action: Mark exact times as "exact" and estimates as "approximate".

STM_024.title: Distance units do not match
STM_024.what: Distances in trip stop times and in route shapes appear to use different units (e.g. metres and kilometres).
STM_024.action: Use the same unit in both places when exporting distances.

STM_025.title: Very short time between two stops
STM_025.what: The scheduled time between two consecutive stops is under 10 seconds. This alone is not an error, just a signal to check.
STM_025.action: If the stops really are very close, no action is needed; otherwise review the times.

STM_026.title: Very long distance between two stops
STM_026.what: There is an unusually long distance between two consecutive stops of the trip; the stop order or location may be wrong.
STM_026.action: Check the trip’s stop order and these two stops’ locations.

STM_028.title: Trip duration very long
STM_028.what: The time between the trip start time and the arrival at the last stop exceeds the expected upper limit.
STM_028.action: Check the first and last stop times; if the trip really is this long, consider splitting it into several trips.

STM_029.title: Trip duration very short
STM_029.what: The time between the trip start time and the arrival at the last stop is much shorter than expected.
STM_029.action: Check the trip’s first and last stop times and whether its stop list is complete.

STM_030.title: Distance along the shape negative
STM_030.what: The shape distance entered for a stop is below zero.
STM_030.action: Enter the distance as zero or a positive value, or leave it empty if you do not use distances.

STM_032.title: Same stop sequence used twice in a trip
STM_032.what: Two stops of the same trip share a sequence number; the order the stops are served is unclear.
STM_032.action: Fix the trip’s stop order so each stop has a distinct, increasing number.

STM_033.title: Trip has a single stop
STM_033.what: This trip has only one stop; riders cannot travel anywhere with it.
STM_033.action: Add at least the first and last stops to the trip, or delete this unused trip.

STM_034.title: Only arrival or only departure at a stop
STM_034.what: Only one of the arrival and departure times is entered at a stop.
STM_034.action: Enter both times; if the vehicle does not wait they can be the same. If the time is unknown, leave both empty.

STM_035.title: Same stop twice in a row
STM_035.what: The same stop appears in two consecutive rows of the trip.
STM_035.action: If this is a terminal or loop turn this is fine; otherwise remove the extra row.

STM_036.title: Trip stop times not sorted in the file
STM_036.what: Trip stop times are not ordered by trip and stop sequence in the file. Analyzer sorts them itself; this is for information.
STM_036.action: Sorting records by trip and stop order when exporting lets some apps read the file faster.

STM_037.title: Fixed times at a demand-responsive stop
STM_037.what: A stop working with a time window (demand-responsive) also has fixed arrival and departure times; the two cannot be combined.
STM_037.action: If this stop is demand-responsive, delete the fixed times and keep only the time window.

STM_038.title: Demand-responsive window reversed
STM_038.what: The end of the demand-responsive service window is not after its start; the window never opens.
STM_038.action: Correct the window so it starts before it ends.

STM_039.title: Demand-responsive window missing
STM_039.what: In a demand-responsive service area, the start or end time of service (or both) is missing.
STM_039.action: Enter both the start and end times of the service window.

STM_040.title: No booking rule at a demand-responsive stop
STM_040.what: A stop working with a time window does not define how riders book.
STM_040.action: Choose the pickup or drop-off booking rule for this stop.

STM_041.title: Stop and service area chosen together
STM_041.what: The same trip row has both a regular stop and a demand-responsive service area; only one is allowed.
STM_041.action: If the row is a regular stop, remove the service area; if it is demand-responsive, remove the stop.

STM_042.title: Stop headsign has characters Google Transit does not support
STM_042.what: The headsign shown at the stop contains special characters that Google Maps does not display. If you do not publish to Google, this is not a problem.
STM_042.action: Replace the special characters in the headsign with plain letters and digits.

STM_043.title: Trip has more than 200 stops
STM_043.what: This trip has an unusual number of stops; several trips may have been merged.
STM_043.action: Check the trip’s stop list; split merged trips if any.

STM_044.title: Trip stop times very large
STM_044.what: The dataset has more than 2 million stop time records; some browser-based tools may slow down at this size.
STM_044.action: This is not an error. If needed, consider splitting the dataset by area or period.

STM_045.title: Trip leaves outside the service day
STM_045.what: The trip’s departure time exceeds the usual end of the service day (27:00 by default).
STM_045.action: Check the departure time; if it is a trip of the next day, move it to the right day and calendar.

STM_046.title: Stop time not linked to a trip
STM_046.what: A stop time record does not say which trip it belongs to.
STM_046.action: Match the stop time to its trip.

STM_047.title: Some trips are missing exact stop times
STM_047.what: Some stops on these trips do not have an exact arrival or departure time.
STM_047.action: Complete the stop times or correct the missing exact times.

STM_048.title: Stop times after midnight written as 00:xx
STM_048.what: The trip runs past midnight, but from one stop onward the times are written as 00:xx instead of 24:xx, so the clock drops back from the previous stop. The trip's start time is correct; the problem is in the stop times within the trip.
STM_048.action: Starting at the stop shown in the table, continue this trip's stop times past 24:00 (24:10 instead of 00:10).

STM_049.title: Departure after midnight at a stop written as 00:xx
STM_049.what: Midnight passes while the vehicle waits at the stop; arrival is written as 23:xx and departure as 00:xx, so the departure appears before the arrival.
STM_049.action: Write this stop's departure time past 24:00 (24:02 instead of 00:02).

STM_050.title: Timepoint flag empty on some rows
STM_050.what: Whether stop times are exact or approximate is left empty on some rows; an empty value counts as "exact".
STM_050.action: Explicitly mark estimated times as "approximate" and real times as "exact".

STM_051.title: Regular pickup at a demand-responsive stop
STM_051.what: At a stop working with a time window, boarding is set to "regular" or "arrange with driver"; this conflicts with demand-responsive service.
STM_051.action: Set boarding at this stop to "none" or "phone booking".

STM_052.title: Regular drop-off at a demand-responsive stop
STM_052.what: At a stop working with a time window, alighting is set to "regular"; this conflicts with demand-responsive service.
STM_052.action: Set alighting at this stop to "none" or "phone booking".

STM_053.title: Same time at many consecutive stops
STM_053.what: Many consecutive stops of a trip have the same time; the vehicle seems to pass them without any time passing.
STM_053.action: Spread the intermediate times by real travel time; if unknown, mark intermediate stops as "approximate".

STM_054.title: Continuous pickup at a demand-responsive stop
STM_054.what: At a stop working with a time window, boarding along the road is left open; the two cannot be combined.
STM_054.action: Switch off continuous pickup at this stop, or leave the setting empty.

STM_055.title: Continuous drop-off at a demand-responsive stop
STM_055.what: At a stop working with a time window, alighting along the road is left open; the two cannot be combined.
STM_055.action: Switch off continuous drop-off at this stop, or leave the setting empty.

STM_056.title: Shape distance does not increase along the trip stops
STM_056.what: The distance along the shape does not increase along the trip’s stops.
STM_056.action: Check the trip’s stop and shape distance information.

STM_058.title: Demand-responsive window time cannot be read
STM_058.what: The start or end of the service window is not a valid time.

STM_059.title: No rule for phone booking
STM_059.what: Boarding or alighting at a stop is set to "phone booking" but how riders book is not defined.
STM_059.action: Choose the relevant booking rule for this stop.

STM_060.title: Two demand-responsive records overlap
STM_060.what: Two demand-responsive records on the same trip overlap in area, time and boarding/alighting rule; it is unclear which applies.
STM_060.action: Separate the time windows or adjust the areas so they do not overlap.

STM_061.title: Impossible speed between distant stops
STM_061.what: The time between two distant stops of a trip is impossibly short for that distance.
STM_061.action: Check the times between these two stops; if they are right, look at the stop locations.

STP_001.title: The same stop ID is used by more than one record
STP_001.what: The same internal stop ID appears more than once in the stop list.
STP_001.action: Merge duplicate records for the same stop or give different stops unique codes.

STP_002.title: Stop code is empty
STP_002.what: A record in the stop list has an empty code; trips cannot be linked to this stop.
STP_002.action: Give each stop a unique code.

STP_003.title: Stop has no name or invalid latitude
STP_003.what: A stop or station has no name, or its latitude is outside the valid range (-90 to 90).
STP_003.action: Give the stop the name riders know and check its location.

STP_004.title: Stop latitude is not a number
STP_004.what: A stop’s latitude cannot be read as a number.
STP_004.action: Enter the latitude as a decimal number with a point (e.g. 37.0662).

STP_005.title: Stop longitude invalid
STP_005.what: A stop’s longitude is not a number or is outside -180 to 180.
STP_005.action: Enter the longitude as a decimal number with a point (e.g. 37.3833).

STP_006.title: Stop latitude missing
STP_006.what: A stop, station or entrance has no latitude; it cannot be shown on the map.
STP_006.action: Mark the stop location in your scheduling software.

STP_007.title: Stop longitude missing
STP_007.what: A stop, station or entrance has no longitude; it cannot be shown on the map.
STP_007.action: Mark the stop location in your scheduling software.

STP_008.title: Stop type invalid
STP_008.what: The type saying whether the record is a stop, station or entrance is not a defined value.
STP_008.action: Choose the right type: stop/platform, station, entrance/exit, generic node or boarding area.

STP_009.title: The station this stop belongs to is missing
STP_009.what: This stop is linked to a station, but that station is not in the stop list.
STP_009.action: Add the station to the stop list or link the stop to an existing station. If the stop does not belong to a station, remove the link.

STP_010.title: Linked record is not a station
STP_010.what: A stop is shown as belonging to a station, but the record it points to is not defined as a station.
STP_010.action: Link the stop to a real station record, or make the linked record a station.

STP_011.title: Entrance or boarding area not linked to a station
STP_011.what: A station entrance, generic node or boarding area is not linked to any station.
STP_011.action: Link this record to its station.

STP_012.title: A station or entrance record is used by a trip
STP_012.what: This record is defined as a station or entrance but is used in trip stop times.
STP_012.action: Use a regular stop record in trip stop times or correct the stop type.

STP_013.title: Stop accessibility value invalid
STP_013.what: The value saying whether the stop is usable by wheelchair is not one of the defined options.

STP_014.title: Stop time zone invalid
STP_014.what: The time zone entered for the stop is not a recognised name.
STP_014.action: Enter the time zone with its standard name, such as "Europe/Istanbul", or leave it empty.

STP_015.title: Stop level not found
STP_015.what: The stop is linked to a level that is not in the level list.
STP_015.action: Add the level to the list, or link the stop to an existing level.

STP_016.title: Two stops at exactly the same place
STP_016.what: Two different stops sit at exactly the same point on the map.
STP_016.action: If they are two records of the same stop, merge them; if they are different stops, enter their correct locations.

STP_017.title: Two stops very close together
STP_017.what: The distance between two different stops is unusually short.
STP_017.action: If one is a copy of the other, merge them; otherwise check their locations.

STP_018.title: No valid stop record
STP_018.what: The stop list contains no usable stop record.
STP_018.action: For services with regular stops, add the stop records. If the dataset uses only demand-responsive service areas this may be valid; the exact rule will be written once the Flex decision is settled.

STP_019.title: Stop name too long
STP_019.what: The stop name is too long to fit on rider screens.
STP_019.action: Use the short name shown on the stop sign.

STP_020.title: Stop served by no trip
STP_020.what: No trip uses this stop; it may appear as an empty stop in rider apps.
STP_020.action: If the stop is not in service, remove it from the list; if it is, add it to the relevant trips.

STP_021.title: Boarding area not linked to a platform
STP_021.what: A boarding area is linked to a record of another type instead of a platform.
STP_021.action: Link the boarding area to its platform.

STP_022.title: Stop code missing
STP_022.what: One or more stops have no rider-facing stop code.
STP_022.action: Fill in the required stop codes.

STP_023.title: Invalid character in spoken stop name
STP_023.what: The stop name written for audio announcements contains characters such as "<" or ">".
STP_023.action: Write the spoken stop name as plain text to be read aloud.

STP_024.title: Stop access value undefined
STP_024.what: The value saying whether the stop can be entered directly from the street is not one of the defined options.
STP_024.action: Choose "only through the station" or "directly from the street".

STP_026.title: Stop access value invalid
STP_026.what: The stop access value can only be one of two options; another value is entered.
STP_026.action: Choose "only through the station" or "directly from the street".

STP_028.title: Stop code too long
STP_028.what: The rider-facing stop code is too long to be a short code.
STP_028.action: Enter the short stop code used on signs and in apps.

STP_029.title: Stop far from its station
STP_029.what: A platform belongs to a station but appears unusually far from it on the map.
STP_029.action: Correct the platform location or which station it belongs to.

STP_030.title: Empty station
STP_030.what: A station is defined but no stop or platform belongs to it.
STP_030.action: Link the station’s platforms to it, or remove the unused station.

STP_031.title: Stop description same as its name
STP_031.what: The stop description repeats its name; it gives riders no extra information.
STP_031.action: Add extra information such as direction, street or platform, or leave it empty.

STP_032.title: Platform with walking connections not linked to a station
STP_032.what: A platform that in-station walking connections attach to is not linked to any station.
STP_032.action: Link the platform to its station.

STP_033.title: Stop fare zone missing
STP_033.what: In a dataset with zone-based fares, some stops have no fare zone.
STP_033.action: If you use zone fares, choose a fare zone for every stop.

STP_034.title: Stop page same as operator page
STP_034.what: The web address given for the stop is the operator’s general page.
STP_034.action: If there is a stop-specific page, enter it; otherwise leave the address empty.

STP_035.title: Stop page same as route page
STP_035.what: The web address given for the stop is a route’s general page.
STP_035.action: If there is a stop-specific page, enter it; otherwise leave the address empty.

STP_036.title: Station linked to another station
STP_036.what: A station is shown as belonging to another record; stations are top-level records.
STP_036.action: Remove the parent record from the station.

STP_037.title: Accessibility of some stops unknown
STP_037.what: Some stops do not say whether they can be used by wheelchair.
STP_037.action: Set accessibility to "accessible" or "not accessible" on the missing stops.

STP_038.title: Accessibility of no stop known
STP_038.what: No stop has wheelchair accessibility information; riders looking for accessible trips get no information.
STP_038.action: Set stop accessibility to "accessible" or "not accessible".

STP_039.title: Same stop code on several stops
STP_039.what: The same rider-facing stop code is used on more than one stop.
STP_039.action: If codes must be unique per stop, give each stop its own code; if the shared code is deliberate this is fine.

STP_040.title: Unnecessary "stop/station" word in the stop name
STP_040.what: A generic word such as "stop" or "station" is added to the stop name.
STP_040.action: Write the stop name without the word, as on the stop sign.

STP_041.title: Platform name does not include the station name
STP_041.what: The name of a platform or stop belonging to a station does not include the station name; riders may not match them.
STP_041.action: Use the station name in the platform name (e.g. "Central Station Platform 2").

STP_042.title: Stop web address invalid
STP_042.what: The web address given for the stop is not valid.
STP_042.action: Enter a full address starting with "https://", or leave it empty.

STP_043.title: Stop access value in the wrong place
STP_043.what: Stop access can only be used on platforms belonging to a station; here it is set on a station, entrance or standalone stop.
STP_043.action: Keep the access value only on platforms belonging to a station and remove it elsewhere.

STP_044.title: Unnecessary word in the platform code
STP_044.what: The platform code contains words such as "Platform"; it should be only the platform number.
STP_044.action: Write the platform code as just a number or letter (e.g. "2", "B").

STP_045.title: Platform number without a station
STP_045.what: A stop has a platform number but does not say which station it is a platform of.
STP_045.action: Link the platform to its station.

TFR_001.title: Time period group is empty
TFR_001.what: A fare time period (e.g. peak hours) record has an empty group code.
TFR_001.action: Enter the group code for the time period.

TFR_002.title: Time period calendar not found
TFR_002.what: A fare time period is linked to a service calendar that is not defined.
TFR_002.action: Link the time period to an existing calendar.

TFR_003.title: Time period time invalid
TFR_003.what: The start or end time of a fare time period cannot be read.

TFR_004.title: Time period reversed
TFR_004.what: The fare time period ends before or at the same time it starts.
TFR_004.action: Correct the start and end times.

TFR_005.title: Time periods overlap
TFR_005.what: Two fare time periods overlap in the same group and calendar; it is unclear which fare applies at that time.
TFR_005.action: Arrange the time periods so they do not overlap.

TFR_006.title: Time period exceeds 24:00
TFR_006.what: A fare time period time is entered beyond 24:00; time periods must stay within one day.
TFR_006.action: Enter times up to 24:00; define the period after midnight separately for the next day.

TFR_007.title: Only one time in a time period
TFR_007.what: Only the start or only the end time of a fare time period is entered.
TFR_007.action: Enter both times, or leave both empty (whole day).

TFR_008.title: Time period calendar is empty
TFR_008.what: A fare time period does not say which calendar it applies to.
TFR_008.action: Choose the calendar for the time period.

TRF_001.title: Transfer from-stop is empty
TRF_001.what: A transfer record has no stop where riders get off.
TRF_001.action: Choose the first stop of the transfer.

TRF_002.title: Transfer to-stop is empty
TRF_002.what: A transfer record has no stop where riders board.
TRF_002.action: Choose the second stop of the transfer.

TRF_003.title: Transfer stop not found
TRF_003.what: A transfer is linked to a stop that is not in the stop list.
TRF_003.action: Link the transfer to an existing stop, or add the stop.

TRF_004.title: Transfer type invalid
TRF_004.what: The transfer type (recommended, timed, minimum time, not possible, in-seat) is not a defined value.

TRF_005.title: Minimum-time transfer has no time
TRF_005.what: A "minimum time required" transfer has no time or an invalid one.
TRF_005.action: Enter the minimum transfer time in seconds.

TRF_006.title: Transfer first trip not found
TRF_006.what: A transfer starts from a trip that is not in the trip list.
TRF_006.action: Link the transfer to an existing trip.

TRF_007.title: Transfer second trip not found
TRF_007.what: A transfer leads to a trip that is not in the trip list.
TRF_007.action: Link the transfer to an existing trip.

TRF_008.title: Transfer first route not found
TRF_008.what: A transfer starts from a route that is not in the route list.
TRF_008.action: Link the transfer to an existing route.

TRF_009.title: Transfer second route not found
TRF_009.what: A transfer leads to a route that is not in the route list.
TRF_009.action: Link the transfer to an existing route.

TRF_010.title: Transfer time very long
TRF_010.what: A transfer’s minimum time is entered as more than one hour.
TRF_010.action: Check the time against the real walking and waiting time.

TRF_011.title: Transfer stops far apart
TRF_011.what: The two stops of a transfer are unusually far apart. This is for information.
TRF_011.action: Check that the stops and the transfer are correct.

TRF_012.title: Same transfer twice
TRF_012.what: The transfer between the same two stops is entered twice.

TRF_013.title: Trip missing in an in-seat transfer
TRF_013.what: In a transfer where riders stay on board, one of the two trips is not given.
TRF_013.action: Choose both the first and second trip for the in-seat transfer.

TRF_014.title: In-seat transfer trip has no times
TRF_014.what: A trip linked by an in-seat transfer has no stop times.
TRF_014.action: Add the stop times of the trip.

TRF_015.title: In-seat transfer attached to a station
TRF_015.what: The in-seat transfer is defined from a station rather than a stop.
TRF_015.action: Attach the in-seat transfer to the relevant stop or platform.

TRF_016.title: Conflicting transfer records
TRF_016.what: Several different transfer rules are entered for the same stop, trip and route.
TRF_016.action: Delete one of the conflicting records.

TRF_017.title: Trip and route do not match in a transfer
TRF_017.what: The trip chosen in a transfer does not belong to the route chosen with it.
TRF_017.action: Match the route in the transfer to the trip’s real route.

TRF_018.title: Transfer linked to the same trip
TRF_018.what: A transfer’s first and second trips are the same.
TRF_018.action: Define the transfer between two different trips.

TRF_019.title: Different vehicle types in an in-seat transfer
TRF_019.what: The two trips joined by an in-seat transfer belong to routes of different vehicle types.
TRF_019.action: Define in-seat transfers between trips of the same vehicle type.

TRF_020.title: Transfer requires running
TRF_020.what: The distance between the two stops can only be covered in the given transfer time by walking very fast.
TRF_020.action: Increase the transfer time to suit the distance.

TRF_021.title: Transfer attached to an entrance or node
TRF_021.what: A transfer is attached to an entrance, generic node or boarding area instead of a stop or station.
TRF_021.action: Attach the transfer to the relevant stop or station.

TRF_022.title: Calendars of continuing trips conflict
TRF_022.what: A trip continues into several trips, but the continuing trips run on the same days; it is unclear which one is taken.
TRF_022.action: Arrange the continuing trips’ calendars so they exclude each other.

TRF_023.title: Calendars of incoming trips conflict
TRF_023.what: Several trips continue into the same trip and the incoming trips run on the same days.
TRF_023.action: Arrange the incoming trips’ calendars so they exclude each other.

TRN_001.title: Invalid table name in a translation
TRN_001.what: A translation points to a file that is not part of GTFS; it is not applied.
TRN_001.action: Export the translations again. This is a file format issue; tell the export software vendor or your IT team.

TRN_002.title: Invalid field in a translation
TRN_002.what: A translation points to a field that does not exist in that file; it is not applied.
TRN_002.action: Export the translations again. This is a file format issue; tell the export software vendor or your IT team.

TRN_003.title: Translation language invalid
TRN_003.what: A translation’s language code is not recognised.
TRN_003.action: Enter the language with a standard code such as "en" or "de".

TRN_004.title: Translated record not found
TRN_004.what: A translation points to a stop, route or record that no longer exists.
TRN_004.action: Link the translation to an existing record, or delete it.

TRN_005.title: Same translation twice
TRN_005.what: The translation of the same text into the same language is entered twice.

TRN_006.title: Two different translations of the same text
TRN_006.what: The same text is translated into the same language in two different ways; apps cannot tell which to show.
TRN_006.action: Keep the right translation and delete the other.

TRN_007.title: Translation in the dataset’s own language
TRN_007.what: Some translations are into the language the dataset already uses; they are unnecessary.
TRN_007.action: Add translations only for other languages.

TRN_008.title: Translation text is empty
TRN_008.what: A translation row has no translated text.
TRN_008.action: Enter the translation, or delete the row.

TRN_009.title: Translation linked to both a record and a text
TRN_009.what: A translation is linked both to a specific record and to a specific text; only one is allowed.
TRN_009.action: Link the translation either by record code or by the text to translate. This is a file format issue; tell the export software vendor or your IT team.

TRN_010.title: Wrong stop order in a stop time translation
TRN_010.what: A translation of a trip stop time points to a stop sequence that is not in the trip.
TRN_010.action: Link the translation to the correct stop sequence. This is a file format issue; tell the export software vendor or your IT team.

TRN_011.title: Non-translatable field translated
TRN_011.what: A translation is entered for a field that cannot be translated, such as a code or a number.
TRN_011.action: Translate only text fields such as names, descriptions and web addresses.

TRN_013.title: Extra fields in a dataset information translation
TRN_013.what: Record link fields that must not be used are filled in a dataset information translation.
TRN_013.action: This is a file format issue; tell the export software vendor or your IT team.

TRN_014.title: Sub-record link in the wrong place
TRN_014.what: The sub-record link, usable only for trip stop times, is used in a translation of another file.
TRN_014.action: This is a file format issue; tell the export software vendor or your IT team.

TRN_015.title: Translation not linked to anything
TRN_015.what: A translation is linked neither to a record nor to a text; it is unknown what it translates.
TRN_015.action: Link the translation to the relevant record or text.

TRN_016.title: Translation matches no text
TRN_016.what: A translation is written for a text that does not exist in the dataset; it is not applied. Usually the text was changed later.
TRN_016.action: Write the text to translate exactly as the current name.

TRN_017.title: Stop order missing in a stop time translation
TRN_017.what: A translation of a trip stop time does not say which stop it is.
TRN_017.action: Add the stop’s sequence to the translation. This is a file format issue; tell the export software vendor or your IT team.

TRP_001.title: Trip code empty or repeated
TRP_001.what: A trip’s code is empty, or the same code is used on two trips; stop times may attach to the wrong trip.
TRP_001.action: Give each trip a unique code.

TRP_002.title: Trip route not found
TRP_002.what: A trip is linked to a route that is not in the route list.
TRP_002.action: Link the trip to an existing route, or add the route to the list.

TRP_003.title: Trip service calendar not found
TRP_003.what: A trip is linked to an undefined service calendar; its running days are unknown.
TRP_003.action: Link the trip to an existing service calendar, or define the calendar.

TRP_004.title: Trip shape not found
TRP_004.what: A trip is linked to a shape that is not among the route shapes.
TRP_004.action: Link the trip to an existing shape, or remove the link.

TRP_005.title: Trip direction invalid
TRP_005.what: The value saying whether a trip is outbound or inbound can only be one of two options; another value is entered.
TRP_005.action: Set the trip direction to "outbound" or "inbound".

TRP_006.title: Trip accessibility value invalid
TRP_006.what: The value saying whether the trip is usable by wheelchair is not one of the defined options.

TRP_007.title: Bicycle permission value invalid
TRP_007.what: The value saying whether bicycles are allowed on the trip is not one of the defined options.

TRP_011.title: Trip direction not shown to riders
TRP_011.what: The trip has neither a headsign nor a trip name; riders cannot see where the vehicle is going.
TRP_011.action: Enter the trip’s headsign (last stop or destination).

TRP_012.title: Direction missing on some trips
TRP_012.what: On a route with outbound and inbound trips, some trips have no direction.
TRP_012.action: Set whether these trips are outbound or inbound.

TRP_013.title: Route has a single trip
TRP_013.what: Only one trip is defined on this route. This is for information.
TRP_013.action: If the route really runs once a day this is fine; otherwise add the missing trips.

TRP_014.title: Trip name too long
TRP_014.what: The trip name (trip number) is longer than 20 characters; it is cut off on rider screens.
TRP_014.action: Put only the short trip number riders see in the trip name.

TRP_015.title: Vehicle block information is not useful
TRP_015.what: Trips have a block code, but no block groups more than one trip; it gives riders no transfer benefit.
TRP_015.action: Give consecutive trips of the same vehicle the same block code, or leave the field empty.

TRP_017.title: Frequency-based trip has no stop times
TRP_017.what: A trip defined by frequency (every X minutes) has no stop times; its stop order and running times are unknown.
TRP_017.action: Enter the stop list and the times between stops for this trip.

TRP_019.title: Continuous boarding without a shape
TRP_019.what: A trip that allows boarding or alighting along the road has no shape; riders cannot see where they can board.

TRP_020.title: Headsign is an intermediate stop name
TRP_020.what: The headsign shown to riders is the name of an intermediate stop rather than the last stop. This may be deliberate.
TRP_020.action: If the headsign shows an important intermediate point this is fine; otherwise use the last stop.

TRP_021.title: Bicycle permission not given
TRP_021.what: No trip says whether bicycles are allowed.
TRP_021.action: Set bicycle permission to "allowed" or "not allowed" on trips.

TRP_022.title: Trips of the same vehicle overlap
TRP_022.what: The times of two trips in the same vehicle block overlap; one vehicle cannot run two trips at once.
TRP_022.action: Correct the vehicle block or the trip times.

TRP_023.title: No active trips in the next 7 days
TRP_023.what: No trip in this dataset runs in the next 7 days.
TRP_023.action: Check the service calendar and trip dates.

TRP_024.title: Different vehicle types in the same block
TRP_024.what: Trips in the same vehicle block belong to routes of different vehicle types (e.g. bus and tram).
TRP_024.action: Limit vehicle blocks to trips of the same vehicle type.

TRP_025.title: Accessibility unknown for most trips
TRP_025.what: More than 80% of trips have no wheelchair accessibility information.
TRP_025.action: Set trip accessibility to "accessible" or "not accessible".

TRP_026.title: Trip runs on no day
TRP_026.what: The trip’s service calendar has no running day; the trip may not be shown in rider apps.
TRP_026.action: Add running days to the calendar, or link the trip to the right calendar.

TRP_028.title: Accessibility unknown for some trips
TRP_028.what: Some trips have no wheelchair accessibility information.
TRP_028.action: Set accessibility to "accessible" or "not accessible" on the missing trips.

TRP_029.title: Accessibility unknown for all trips
TRP_029.what: No trip has wheelchair accessibility information; riders looking for accessible trips get no information.
TRP_029.action: Set trip accessibility to "accessible" or "not accessible".

TRP_031.title: Trip not linked to a route
TRP_031.what: A trip does not say which route it belongs to.
TRP_031.action: Match the trip to the correct route.

TRP_032.title: Car carriage value invalid
TRP_032.what: The value saying whether cars can be carried on the trip (e.g. ferry) is not one of the defined options.

TRP_034.title: Demand-responsive duration factor not a number
TRP_034.what: The factor or offset used to calculate travel time on demand-responsive trips cannot be read as a number.
TRP_034.action: Enter the factor and offset as decimal numbers.

TRP_035.title: Trip service calendar not given
TRP_035.what: A trip does not say on which days it runs.
TRP_035.action: Choose or create a service calendar for the trip.

VAT_001.title: Two routes on almost the same path
VAT_001.what: Two routes of the same type serve largely the same stops; they may be two copies of the same route.
VAT_001.action: If they really are separate routes this is fine; if they are copies, merge them.

VAT_002.title: No transfer defined at a multi-route stop
VAT_002.what: Four or more routes serve this stop but no transfer is defined. This is for information.
VAT_002.action: If a specific transfer time or rule is needed, add transfer information; otherwise no action is needed.

VAT_003.title: Trip duration very different from similar trips
VAT_003.what: Compared with trips on the same path, this trip is unusually long or short. This is for information.
VAT_003.action: If there is a reason such as peak traffic or a different vehicle this is fine; otherwise check the trip times.

VAT_005.title: Group of stops cut off from the network
VAT_005.what: Some stops are not connected by trips to the rest of the network; they form an island.
VAT_005.action: Check the trips and stop times that use these stops.

VAT_006.title: Most trips on one route
VAT_006.what: Most trips in the dataset are on a single route. This is for information.
VAT_006.action: If the route really is that busy this is fine; otherwise check that the other routes’ trips were exported.

VAT_007.title: No transfer at a terminal stop
VAT_007.what: Another route also reaches a route’s terminal stop, but no transfer is defined. This is for information.
VAT_007.action: If a specific transfer rule is needed, add transfer information.

VAT_008.title: Same shape used on many routes
VAT_008.what: One route shape is used on more than 30% of routes; routes may have been given the wrong shape.
VAT_008.action: Define its own shape for each route and direction.

XFL_002.title: Trip has no stop times
XFL_002.what: This trip has no stop times at all; it may not be shown in rider apps.
XFL_002.action: Add the trip’s stop times, or delete the unused trip.

XFL_006.title: Calendar contains only cancellations
XFL_006.what: A service calendar consists only of dates added as "not running"; it has no running day.
XFL_006.action: Add running days to the calendar.

XFL_012.title: Route has no operating trips
XFL_012.what: This route has trips but none has stop times; the route may not be shown in rider apps.
XFL_012.action: Add stop times to the route’s trips, or remove the route.

XFL_013.title: Shape used in both directions
XFL_013.what: The same route shape is used by outbound and inbound trips; the line appears reversed in one direction.
XFL_013.action: Use separate shapes for outbound and inbound.

XFL_014.title: Translated record not found
XFL_014.what: A translation points to a record that no longer exists.
XFL_014.action: Delete the translation or restore the record.

XFL_015.title: Attribution linked to a missing record
XFL_015.what: An attribution record is linked to an operator, route or trip that does not exist.
XFL_015.action: Link the attribution to an existing record.

XFL_016.title: Dataset information translated but file missing
XFL_016.what: A translation is entered for dataset information, but there is no dataset information file.
XFL_016.action: Add the dataset information, or delete the related translation.

XFL_019.title: Route network defined in two places
XFL_019.what: Which network routes belong to is entered both in the route list and in a separate network file.
XFL_019.action: Keep the network information in one place.

XFL_020.title: Trip and route do not match in a transfer
XFL_020.what: The trip chosen in a transfer does not belong to the route chosen with it.
XFL_020.action: Match the route in the transfer to the trip’s real route.

XFL_021.title: Trip does not pass the transfer stop
XFL_021.what: The trip chosen in a transfer does not pass the stop where the transfer is defined.
XFL_021.action: Attach the transfer to a stop the trip passes.

XFL_022.title: Stop group not found
XFL_022.what: A group–stop link points to a stop group that is not defined.
XFL_022.action: Define the stop group, or delete the link.

XFL_023.title: Stop in the group not found
XFL_023.what: A stop group contains a stop that is not in the stop list.
XFL_023.action: Add an existing stop to the group.

XFL_024.title: Trip stop group not found
XFL_024.what: A demand-responsive trip is linked to a stop group that is not defined.
XFL_024.action: Link the trip to an existing stop group.

XFL_025.title: Trip service area not found
XFL_025.what: A demand-responsive trip is linked to a service area that is not defined.
XFL_025.action: Link the trip to an existing service area, or add the area.

XFL_027.title: Contactless payment information differs
XFL_027.what: The route’s contactless payment information differs from that in the fare definitions; the fare definitions take precedence. This is for information.

XFL_028.title: Operator says contactless, fares do not
XFL_028.what: The operator is marked as supporting contactless payment, but the fare definitions have no contactless medium.
XFL_028.action: Add the contactless medium to the fare definitions.

XFL_029.title: Route says contactless, fares do not
XFL_029.what: A route is marked as supporting contactless payment, but the fare definitions have no contactless medium.
XFL_029.action: Add the contactless medium to the fare definitions.

XFL_030.title: Contactless payment exists but is not marked
XFL_030.what: The fare definitions have a contactless medium, but no operator or route says it supports it.
XFL_030.action: Mark the operators or routes where contactless payment applies.

XFL_031.title: Same code for a stop and an area
XFL_031.what: A stop, service area or stop group share the same code; trips may be linked to the wrong place.
XFL_031.action: Change one of the conflicting codes.

XFL_032.title: Stop group code is empty
XFL_032.what: A stop group has an empty code.
XFL_032.action: Give each stop group a unique code.

XFL_033.title: Group code empty in a group–stop link
XFL_033.what: A group–stop link does not say which group it belongs to.
XFL_033.action: Enter the group code for the link.

XFL_034.title: Stop empty in a group–stop link
XFL_034.what: A group–stop link does not say which stop it is.
XFL_034.action: Enter the stop for the link.
